The segment shows a scene from the late-night talk show "The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson." The video begins with the host, Craig Ferguson, dressed in a suit and tie, seated at his desk. He is engaged in a conversation with Christina Hendricks, who is seated in an armchair. Hendricks is wearing a black lace dress. Ferguson is gesticulating while speaking, and Hendricks is laughing. A cityscape is visible behind them through a window. As the conversation progresses, Ferguson makes a joke, causing Hendricks to laugh heartily. He then declares they are running out of time and offers Hendricks a choice between a "mouth organ, awkward pause" or "throwing Frisbees at a horse." Hendricks asks for the first option, mouth organ, leading Ferguson to retrieve a harmonica from his desk. He hands it to Hendricks. After a short break, both begin to play the harmonica simultaneously, concluding the segment. At the end, text appears on the screen: "The End, Outro Coming...". The text indicates the end of the program segment.
